brief:
Growing concerns mount over Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's push to intensify confrontation across multiple fronts, particularly with Iran and Gaza, as he faces mounting domestic crises, Shehab Wire reported. Analysts warn the escalation strategy may serve as a distraction from internal political and legal pressures bearing down on his government.

The renewed aggression risks destabilizing the entire region, observers cautioned, with potential consequences extending far beyond current conflict zones.

title: Netanyahu escalates regional tensions ahead of potential power loss
